chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Fans who listened as well as danced
summary: There were fans in the late 1920s who invited musicians home and listened as well as danced.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Were there people then in the USA, in the late Twenties, who were what you might call fans of the musicians and who would come out and maybe invite you to their house and stuff?
Sure, there would be. Yeah, sure.
So they were listening to the music as well as dancing to it.
Yeah. Mmm-hmm. They'd dance and listen.
